## JobCairn 0.3.4

JobCairn now runs on Windows, as a beta. On the Mac: updates from your mail, and three more job sites.

### Updating
Mac, from 0.2.0 or later: click the version number in the sidebar, then **Restart**. Your workspace isn't affected.

Windows: this is the first Windows version, so download the installer below.

### New
- **Windows beta.** JobCairn for Windows 10 and 11, on most PCs (x64) and Arm PCs. Setup installs what it needs with winget, Windows' own App Installer: Claude Code (with Git for Windows, which Claude Code needs there), Node.js, Python, ffmpeg and Chrome. Later updates install from inside the app.
- **Updates from your mail.** When mail sync sees an application receipt, an interview invite, a rejection or an offer, Mail shows it in **Updates from your mail** with **Update to …** and **Dismiss**. Nothing changes until you click, and Home shows how many are waiting.
- **More job sites.** Links from PageUp, Jobvite and Teamtailor are named, checked for look-alike addresses, and matched when the same ad turns up twice.

### Improved
- Research ideas and examples are general, not tied to one role or country.

### Download
- **Mac, Apple silicon (M1 or later):** `JobCairn-0.3.4-arm64.dmg`
- **Mac, Intel:** `JobCairn-0.3.4-x64.dmg`
- **Windows, most PCs:** `JobCairn-0.3.4-x64.exe`
- **Windows, Arm PCs:** `JobCairn-0.3.4-arm64.exe`

Not sure which?
- Mac: Apple menu › About This Mac. **Chip** means Apple silicon; **Processor** means Intel.
- Windows: Settings › System › About › **System type** says x64-based or ARM-based.

The Mac apps are signed with an Apple Developer ID and notarised by Apple.

### Installing on Windows (not code-signed)
The Windows installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows warns you before it runs:
1. If your browser says the file isn't commonly downloaded, choose **Keep** (in Edge: **…** › **Keep** › **Show more** › **Keep anyway**).
2. Open the installer. When **Windows protected your PC** appears, choose **More info**, check the app is `JobCairn-0.3.4-…exe`, then **Run anyway**.
3. It installs for your account only, with no admin password. Some tools Setup installs later may ask for permission.

If **Smart App Control** is on in Windows 11, it blocks unsigned apps and has no Run anyway option, so JobCairn can't be installed while it's on. On some versions of Windows, turning it off can't be undone without resetting Windows, so decide for yourself.

The source code is public in this repo. The [install guide](https://jobcairn.github.io/install.html) has the full steps.

### Check your download
In the folder with your download and `SHA256SUMS.txt`:

- Mac: `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt --ignore-missing`
- Windows, in PowerShell: `Get-FileHash .\JobCairn-0.3.4-x64.exe -Algorithm SHA256`, then compare with the matching line in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

### Needs
macOS 13 (Ventura) or later, or Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), and a Claude plan that includes Claude Code.

Questions? Ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/JobCairn/jobcairn/discussions), without personal details.

If JobCairn helps, please ⭐ star the repo. It helps others find it.
